findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian translation of totpStep1 was replaced with Italian ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'). Lithuanian users will see Italian. The same mistake is in login/messages_lt.properties loginTotpStep1 (line 71).

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file gets Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new totpStep1 value '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：' is Traditional Chinese, placed in the zh_CN (Simplified) bundle. Simplified Chinese users get inconsistent script.

findings.title: ICU/MessageFormat syntax used in i18next bundle
findings.body: The account-ui uses i18next with {{0}} interpolation, as every other key in this file does. Changing error-invalid-multivalued-size to Java MessageFormat '{0}' and '{2,choice,...}' means the placeholders will no longer be substituted and the raw choice syntax will be shown to users. The same problem applies to the admin-ui messages_en.properties.

findings.title: Anchor check leaves unmatched English anchors and compares by position only
findings.body: santizeAnchors removes the first textual occurrence of the English anchor instead of the matched position. It only checks that translated anchors appear in order. If the translation drops a closing , the remaining tags are passed to the sanitizer, which removes and reports a confusing result. There is also no check for href-only differences in attribute order or quoting.

findings.title: Missing English file throws RuntimeException and breaks build
findings.body: The English file path is derived by regex. If no matching _en file exists, for example for a file without a locale suffix or a theme with no English base, a RuntimeException is thrown. This bypasses the MojoExecutionException handling. The replaceAll on 'resources-community' also rewrites any path segment that contains that substring.
